data.title: 加藤惠 · 周末服装店的认真挑选·「这两件衣服……伦也君觉得哪一件更好看呢」
data.description: 【商业街服装店试衣区·周末】在琳琅满目的衣架前，惠手里拿着两件不同风格的夏日连衣裙在身前比划。低头认真看着吊牌与面料搭配，没有摆拍的做作，尽显普通女高纯真自然的生活审美。
data.action: 身前比划连衣裙认真低头比对，马尾微晃，眼神专注沉吟
data.lighting: 精品店暖色射灯与镜面柔和反光
data.camera: medium shot, holding clothes, shopping date, natural expression
data.promptProse: Megumi Kato holds two summer dresses against herself in the boutique fitting area, studying their tags and fabric combinations. Her own pastel-pink sleeveless knit top and cream pleated midi skirt remain visible, brown hair tied in a practical ponytail. The medium view includes nearby hangers and a side mirror reflecting the garments. Warm boutique spots illuminate the held cloth and scrunchie, with softer mirror light on her thoughtful face.
